overview.text: The Australian Public Service Commission's combined annual report for 2025–26 covers the Commission and the Merit Protection Commissioner's annual report.

The Merit Protection Commissioner's section reports on the office's statutory review functions under the Public Service Act 1999, including Code of Conduct reviews, promotion reviews and own motion audits.
overview.support: We conduct merit reviews of employment decisions to make sure they are correct, fair and lawful.

overview.text: The report records that 109 applications for review of Code of Conduct decisions were received in 2025–26, and that 40% of Code of Conduct decisions reviewed were set aside or varied.
overview.support: We set aside or varied 40% of Code of Conduct decisions.

overview.text: The Merit Protection Commissioner stated that in almost 40% of Code of Conduct decisions reviewed this year the office identified issues that required the original decision to be set aside or varied.
overview.support: in almost 40% of Code of Conduct decisions reviewed this year we identified issues that required the original decision to be set aside or varied

overview.text: The Commission's section reports on its performance against six measures for 2025–26, with four achieved, one substantially achieved and one partially achieved.
overview.support: of our 6 performance measures we achieved the targets for 4 measures, substantially achieved the targets for one measure, and partially achieved the targets for one measure.

findings.quote: We set aside or varied 40% of decisions of Code of Conduct breaches and sanctions that we reviewed.
It is therefore significant that in almost 40% of Code of Conduct decisions reviewed this year we identified issues that required the original decision to be set aside or varied.
